rationale.usefulness: The typed graph, core templates and reusable workflow exports provide substantial actionable value for creative builders (creative-cf-workflow); explicit maintenance and review guidance keeps proposed classroom applications proportionate.
rationale.impact: Local extensible inference, media-processing stages and an application API can materially affect creative production infrastructure (creative-cf-repo), but the evidence does not demonstrate a field-wide model advance or measured educational gains.
rationale.novelty: Inspectable composition and recoverable workflow metadata are meaningful differentiation (creative-cf-workflow); this is an established baseline, with no supported new breakthrough or comparative uniqueness.
rationale.maturity: Detailed official workflow and dependency documentation and the maintained core repository support usable production experimentation; extension conflicts and absent hands-on reliability tests prevent an exceptional readiness rating.
rationale.openness: Public GPL-3.0 core, local execution/API and JSON graphs provide strong inspectability and portability (creative-cf-repo; creative-cf-license). Copyleft conditions, separate model/node terms and missing dependency capture limit reproducibility.

concerns: Non-blocking: four official pages belong to one source family; this review verifies documented capabilities, not experimental outcomes.
